responses.question: Which do you like to watch more: people singing or people cooking?
angles: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較

arguments.title: 較喜歡歌唱因為歌曲能觸動情緒
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 音樂可以透過旋律和歌詞引發情感，觀看時亦不需要知道太多技術細節。喜歡歌唱的學生可談及自己與某種歌曲風格的連結。
arguments.englishDemo: I prefer **singing performances** because **meaningful lyrics**, **memorable melodies** and **emotional expression** create a strong **personal connection**. I find this more moving than a visual spectacle.

arguments.title: 較喜歡烹飪因為技能貼近日常生活
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 烹飪節目展示食材搭配及料理決策，讓觀眾想到自己也可能在家嘗試。若考生重視實用價值，這是一個自然的比較角度。
arguments.englishDemo: I enjoy **cooking contests** because **practical skills**, **food preparation** and **new recipes** are relevant to **daily life**. Those ideas might be useful at home.

arguments.title: 歌唱表演較方便與家人一起欣賞
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 熟悉歌曲能讓不同年齡的家庭成員一起跟唱或分享回憶。這種共同體驗可能比單純研究烹飪技巧更符合某些人的娛樂偏好。
arguments.englishDemo: **Familiar songs** can inspire **family singalongs** and **shared memories**. I value this **social enjoyment** more than **technical cooking details**. This is particularly enjoyable when the songs are familiar.

arguments.title: 料理比賽的作品結果較容易直接看到
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 做出的菜式通常可以從外觀、配搭和完成度觀察成果。雖然電視觀眾未必能真正品嚐味道，但創作流程仍能提供具體欣賞重點。
arguments.englishDemo: A **finished dish** provides a **visible result**. Viewers can judge **presentation skills** and **creative combinations**, although **actual flavour** cannot be tasted through a screen.

arguments.title: 歌唱節目能欣賞更豐富的現場感染力
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 聲線、節奏、燈光和觀眾反應結合起來，可能產生較強的現場情緒。喜歡音樂的學生可以用這些細節說明選擇。
arguments.englishDemo: **Live vocals**, **rhythmic energy**, **stage lighting** and **audience reactions** create an **exciting atmosphere** that appeals to me. A great song can transform the whole mood.

arguments.title: 烹飪題材可以刺激自己嘗試新事物
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 觀看選手處理少見食材或創作菜式，觀眾可能得到靈感並想了解更多。考生可以認同這種探索價值，同時強調應使用安全可靠的方法。
arguments.englishDemo: **Unfamiliar ingredients** and **creative recipes** encourage **culinary curiosity**. I enjoy the **learning process** and seek **safe guidance** before experimenting. Experiments should still respect basic kitchen safety.

arguments.title: 歌唱技巧較能直接從音訊感受
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 即使沒有觀看畫面，觀眾仍能從聲音聽到部分音準、節奏和演繹差異。這對偏重聆聽體驗的人較具吸引力，但聲音設備也會影響感受。
arguments.englishDemo: **Vocal control**, **pitch accuracy**, **musical phrasing** and **expressive delivery** can be appreciated through **careful listening**, even without watching every image.

arguments.title: 烹飪比賽的團隊任務更能展示合作
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 模擬餐廳的挑戰使選手需要協調準備、出菜和顧客需要。喜歡觀察團隊解難的人可能比起純表演更喜歡這種真實任務。
arguments.englishDemo: **Team cooking** reveals **role allocation**, **time coordination**, **service pressure** and **practical teamwork**. I find these real-world challenges fascinating. It also shows how pressure changes decisions.

arguments.title: 兩者都喜歡但可按心情選擇
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 學生未必一定要在歌唱和烹飪之間永久選一種。想放鬆時可聽歌，想獲得生活靈感時可看煮食，選擇取決於當天需要。
arguments.englishDemo: My **viewing preference** depends on my **current mood**. I choose **singing shows** for **emotional enjoyment** and **cooking programmes** for practical ideas.

arguments.title: 兩類節目的評分都不完全客觀
arguments.angle: 歌唱或烹飪：兩種合理偏好與比較
arguments.description: 觀眾能比較技巧，但聲音是否動人和菜式是否美味仍帶有主觀判斷。理解這一點後，學生可以選擇較喜歡的節目，而不必否定另一類型。
arguments.englishDemo: Both **musical taste** and **food preferences** involve **subjective judgement**. **Technical skills** matter, but **personal enjoyment** ultimately guides my viewing choice.

samples.label: Model B｜較喜歡私下發展興趣
samples.text: I prefer **singing performances** because **meaningful lyrics**, **memorable melodies** and **emotional expression** create a strong **personal connection**. I find this more moving than a visual spectacle.

samples.label: Model B｜較喜歡私下發展興趣
samples.text: I enjoy **cooking contests** because **practical skills**, **food preparation** and **new recipes** are relevant to **daily life**. Those ideas might be useful at home.

responses.question: How can young people develop their talents?
angles: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性

arguments.title: 持續而有目的的練習比漫無目標重複有效
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 青年若先找出最需要改善的技巧，再設定短期訓練任務，較容易察覺進步。練習時間本身並不足夠，方法和檢討同樣重要。
arguments.englishDemo: **Deliberate practice** involves **specific goals**, **regular repetition**, **self-assessment** and **gradual improvement**, rather than practising without direction. The aim should be better techniques, not repetition alone.

arguments.title: 導師能協助學習者建立扎實基礎
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 有經驗的老師可及早指出不恰當姿勢、演出方法或料理技巧。這種指導有助避免反覆練錯，但教師質素和學生接受程度也很重要。
arguments.englishDemo: **Qualified mentors** offer **technical guidance**, correct **basic mistakes**, and support **skill foundations**. **Early coaching** can prevent ineffective habits. A good teacher also explains why correction matters.

arguments.title: 建設性回饋可讓練習更有方向
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 同學可向老師、隊友或可信任的觀眾徵求具體意見，再逐步改進。與其只問「好不好」，不如了解哪些部分需要修改。
arguments.englishDemo: **Constructive feedback** identifies **clear strengths** and **areas for improvement**. Students can create **action plans** and track **measurable progress**. Even small changes can make the next attempt stronger.

arguments.title: 嘗試多個領域有助及早發現興趣
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 年輕人未必一開始就知道最適合自己的才藝。學校可提供音樂、舞蹈、戲劇或烹飪等不同體驗，讓學生有機會選擇而非過早定型。
arguments.englishDemo: **Trying different activities** encourages **self-exploration**. Students discover **personal interests**, identify **hidden strengths** and make **informed choices** about future practice. Trying unfamiliar fields is useful before specialising.

arguments.title: 同伴合作能補充個人練習
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 個人練習適合改善基本技巧，合作演出則需要聆聽、配合和即時調整。兩種方法互相補充，有助培養更全面的表演能力。
arguments.englishDemo: **Peer collaboration** develops **active listening**, shared timing and **mutual support**. These strengthen **group performances** beyond what **solo practice** achieves. Together, they reveal weaknesses that individuals may overlook.

arguments.title: 善用錄影可以觀察自己的表現
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 學生在表演當下未必知道表情、節奏或肢體動作的實際效果。經同意及保護私隱的自我錄影，可供回看和反思，但不需要公開發布。
arguments.englishDemo: **Self-recording** allows **performance review**. Students can notice **small errors**, adjust **body language** and monitor **skill improvement** privately. Comparisons across recordings may reveal gradual changes.

arguments.title: 設定分階段目標可避免因進步緩慢放棄
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 較大的夢想如果沒有小步驟，可能令學習者感到遙不可及。先完成可實現的練習任務，再逐步增加難度，有助保持動力。
arguments.englishDemo: **Short-term targets** make **long-term ambitions** manageable. Completing **small milestones** builds **motivation** and supports **steady progress**. The next challenge should be slightly harder.

arguments.title: 充足休息能支持長期學習
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 密集練習固然重要，但若長期犧牲睡眠和休閒，可能增加疲勞和不良情緒。平衡訓練、學業與休息，比短期過度操練更可持續。
arguments.englishDemo: **Rest and recovery** support **sustainable training**. Students need **balanced routines**, **adequate sleep** and **realistic workloads** alongside practice. Rest can make the next session more effective.

arguments.title: 家庭鼓勵可令青年更有信心
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 家人可以透過聆聽演出、提供交通或支持學習選擇來幫忙。鼓勵不應變成強迫，更不應把家人的期望等同孩子自己的目標。
arguments.englishDemo: **Family encouragement** can provide **emotional support**, **practical help** and **confidence building**. Respecting **personal choice** makes that support healthier. Pressure is less helpful than steady encouragement.

arguments.title: 學校應讓資源有限者也有練習機會
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 不是所有家庭都負擔得起私人課堂或器材。學校若提供可負擔活動與共享設備，可減少起點差距，讓努力真正有發揮空間。
arguments.englishDemo: **Affordable lessons**, **shared equipment** and **school opportunities** can improve **equal access** to **talent development**. Not everyone can afford private coaching or instruments.

arguments.title: 欣賞不同形式的藝術可增加創意
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 青年除了練自己熟悉的項目，也可觀察音樂、舞蹈、電影和其他文化作品。跨領域觀察可能刺激新想法，但應尊重原作者及作品脈絡。
arguments.englishDemo: **Artistic exposure** across **different disciplines** expands **creative thinking**. Students may find **new inspiration** and build **broader perspectives**. Ideas may transfer between otherwise different fields.

arguments.title: 安全的失敗環境能鼓勵不斷嘗試
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 若每次練習失誤都受到嘲笑，學生可能不敢嘗試新方法。導師營造尊重氛圍，能讓青年把錯誤視為改善線索而非個人失敗。
arguments.englishDemo: A **supportive environment** encourages **learning from mistakes**. Without **fear of ridicule**, students can take **creative risks** and develop **greater confidence**.

arguments.title: 讓青年自主安排部分學習內容可提高投入
arguments.angle: 青年才能發展：方法、資源、反饋及可持續性
arguments.description: 如果學生能參與選擇曲目、練習目標或作品方向，往往更清楚自己在努力甚麼。選擇權可提高責任感，但不代表完全不需要專業建議。
arguments.englishDemo: **Student choice** strengthens **personal ownership** of learning. Selecting **meaningful goals** and **suitable projects** may improve **long-term engagement**. This can help learners stay committed for longer.

samples.label: Model B｜烹飪：創意與生活實用性
samples.text: A **supportive environment** encourages **learning from mistakes**. Without **fear of ridicule**, students can take **creative risks** and develop **greater confidence**.

samples.label: Model A｜有方向的練習與回饋
samples.text: I think young people should practise regularly and set specific goals instead of repeating the same activity without thinking. A good teacher can point out weaknesses, while recording a performance allows students to review their progress. Most importantly, they need time to make mistakes, receive constructive feedback and improve gradually.

responses.question: Do you agree that talent can be developed through hard work?
angles: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件

arguments.title: 勤奮練習通常能改善已有技能
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 即使起點不同，大部分學習者仍可透過合適練習逐步改進某些技能。努力重要，但需要配合方法、回饋和時間才能得到較穩定的效果。
arguments.englishDemo: **Consistent effort** supports **skill improvement**, especially with **effective practice**, **useful feedback** and **realistic goals**. Students should also learn from each attempt, not merely repeat it.

arguments.title: 天生優勢可能影響初期速度但非全部
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 有些人在聽覺、動作協調或表達方面較易上手，但早期優勢不能保證長期表現。持續學習和興趣會影響能力能否穩定發展。
arguments.englishDemo: **Natural aptitude** may influence **early progress**, but **long-term achievement** also depends on **continued learning** and **personal commitment**. This distinction matters when we compare individual learners.

arguments.title: 努力的方向比單純花費時數重要
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 無目的重複可能令學生一直犯同一錯誤。較有效的方法是找出問題、調整策略並評估改變，讓付出的時間真正對應需要。
arguments.englishDemo: **Hours of practice** alone cannot replace **focused training**. **Identifying mistakes**, **changing strategies** and **measuring progress** make effort more productive. The same routine may otherwise preserve poor habits.

arguments.title: 資源差距會影響勤奮能帶來的成果
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 同樣努力的兩個學生可能擁有不同導師、練習空間和設備。比較成就時應留意機會差距，而不能一概認為不成功的人不夠努力。
arguments.englishDemo: **Unequal resources** affect **training quality**, **access to coaching** and available time. **Hard work** therefore operates under **different conditions**. Opportunities must be considered before blaming an individual.

arguments.title: 興趣與內在動機能支持長時間學習
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 若學生真正喜歡某項活動，可能較願意在遇到困難時繼續。單靠家長或社會壓力，未必可以建立同樣穩定的投入。
arguments.englishDemo: **Genuine interest** supports **intrinsic motivation**. This encourages **regular engagement**, **persistence** and **enjoyment of learning** beyond external rewards. Motivation often matters when improvement becomes slow.

arguments.title: 適當休息也是有效努力的一部分
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 持續練習不代表每天都要操練到極限。休息可減少疲勞，讓學生以較穩定的精神投入下一次練習。
arguments.englishDemo: **Balanced training** includes **rest periods**, **fatigue management** and **healthy routines**. These support **consistent performance** rather than relentless practice. Working harder is not always the same as learning better.

arguments.title: 回饋與良師能讓努力更有效率
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 有人即使勤奮，仍可能因方法錯誤而難以改善。善用教師意見和合適資源，有助更快發現問題，減少無效重複。
arguments.englishDemo: **Expert guidance** improves **practice quality** through **timely correction**. Students can avoid **repeated errors** and make **meaningful progress**. Poor methods can otherwise waste considerable time.

arguments.title: 機會與時機亦會影響是否被看見
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 一個人可以有出色能力，卻未必有資源登上大型舞台。努力能改善表現，但曝光和市場需求是另外的條件。
arguments.englishDemo: **Talent development** differs from **public recognition**. **Access to opportunities**, **market timing** and **audience demand** can affect success beyond practice. Effort can prepare someone without creating an opening.

arguments.title: 不同才能需要不同方法和時間
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 唱歌、烹飪和舞蹈的身體及思考要求不同，不能用同一套練習安排套用所有人。找出符合活動本身的學習方式，比盲目比較速度重要。
arguments.englishDemo: **Different talents** require **specific techniques**, **appropriate practice** and **individual pacing**. **Flexible learning methods** support development better than uniform expectations. A method that helps a singer may not suit a dancer.

arguments.title: 失敗經驗可以成為改善的重要資訊
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 選手未能晉級不一定代表沒有天分，亦可能是某項能力未準備好。仔細檢討具體問題，再決定繼續方向，較有助長遠成長。
arguments.englishDemo: **Initial setbacks** can provide **valuable lessons**. With **honest reflection**, **new strategies** and **continued effort**, students may improve after failure. This works best when feedback is specific.

arguments.title: 勤奮可以改善才能但不能保證每人當冠軍
arguments.angle: 先天條件、後天練習與成功條件
arguments.description: 節目獎項名額有限，即使多名參賽者都認真努力，也只有少數能得獎。把努力和具體進步相連，比把獎項當成唯一證明更合理。
arguments.englishDemo: **Hard work** can build **better skills** without guaranteeing **competition victory**. **Limited prizes** make **personal progress** a more dependable measure. Other contestants may also have trained extremely hard.

samples.label: Model A｜基本同意，強調練習方法
samples.text: Yes, to a large extent. Hard work gives people repeated opportunities to correct mistakes and build skills that they did not have at the beginning. For example, a young singer may gradually improve their breathing and timing through practice. However, the practice needs to be purposeful, not simply long and exhausting.

samples.label: Model B｜有條件同意，兼顧資源差距
samples.text: I partly agree. Effort certainly matters, but students also need suitable guidance, time and opportunities to practise. Someone with access to lessons and equipment may progress faster than an equally hardworking person without those resources. Therefore, I would say that hard work develops talent, but it does not guarantee the same result for everyone.

responses.question: Do you think people can develop a new talent later in life?
angles: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展

arguments.title: 成年人仍可透過學習培養全新興趣
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 成年人可能在工作或家庭生活中接觸以前沒有嘗試的活動。只要找到適合的學習方法和時間，仍有機會逐步掌握新技能。
arguments.englishDemo: **Adult learning** allows **new interests** to develop through **regular practice**, **accessible lessons** and **personal curiosity**. They do not need to become professionals to benefit.

arguments.title: 轉換生活階段可能帶來新的學習動機
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 有人退休、轉工或照顧責任改變後，才有空探索藝術或烹飪。生活轉變能提供契機，但仍需要考慮資源與個人情況。
arguments.englishDemo: **Life transitions** can create **fresh motivation** for **new hobbies**. With **available time** and **practical resources**, adults may discover hidden abilities.

arguments.title: 生活經驗可以成為創作素材
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 成年人累積的工作、旅行或家庭經驗，可能為寫作、音樂和其他創作提供不同視角。這種獨特背景能成為長處，並不要求擁有年輕時的訓練經歷。
arguments.englishDemo: **Life experience** supplies **creative inspiration** and **different perspectives**. Adults may express **personal stories** through **new artistic forms**. Such expression does not depend on starting in childhood.

arguments.title: 學習新事物可保持精神活力與社交動機
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 參加音樂或手工班可以讓成年人有規律地接觸新挑戰與其他人。這可能提升生活充實感，但不等同保證預防某種疾病。
arguments.englishDemo: **Learning activities** encourage **mental engagement**, **social interaction** and daily motivation. A **supportive class** may increase **life satisfaction** for some adults.

arguments.title: 工作技能也可在不同年齡重新培養
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 成年人可能因技術更新或職涯轉變，需要學習攝影、剪輯或新的料理方法。這些實用技能能在適當支援下逐步學習，而非只屬年輕人的領域。
arguments.englishDemo: **Career changes** may require **new practical skills**. Through **adult training**, **guided practice** and **steady effort**, workers can adapt. The relevant skills can change with the profession.

arguments.title: 最初學得較慢也不應被視為沒有才能
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 成年人可能需要重新熟悉基礎技巧，學習速度因經驗、健康和時間而不同。與其比較誰較快，不如用個人目標檢視是否取得進展。
arguments.englishDemo: **Different learning speeds** call for **patient instruction**. **Personal progress**, **realistic goals** and **consistent encouragement** matter more than age stereotypes. Improvement can still be meaningful at any pace.

arguments.title: 網上教材可以降低入門障礙
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 一些成年人因工作或家庭責任難以出席固定課堂，可選擇合適的網上教材自主安排時間。它帶來彈性，但未必適合所有需要實體指導的技能。
arguments.englishDemo: **Online tutorials**, **flexible schedules** and **self-paced practice** support **independent learning**. **Hands-on guidance** may still be necessary for some activities. However, feedback from a teacher can remain valuable.

arguments.title: 家庭與社區鼓勵可減少害怕出醜的心態
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 成年人有時擔心自己初學會顯得笨拙，因此不願嘗試。沒有嘲笑的環境和親友支持，可令開始學習變得容易。
arguments.englishDemo: **Fear of embarrassment** may stop adults trying **new activities**. **Family encouragement**, **welcoming groups** and **positive feedback** can reduce that barrier.

arguments.title: 不同年齡的才能不應只以職業成就衡量
arguments.angle: 成年後學習新技能與終身發展
arguments.description: 有人只希望在家做菜、唱歌或創作，而非成為公眾人物。這種私人興趣仍然有價值，成功標準可由本人決定。
arguments.englishDemo: **Personal fulfilment** can matter more than **professional recognition**. Adults may pursue **hobbies for enjoyment**, **creative freedom** and **self-defined success**. The learner gets to decide what achievement means.

samples.label: Model A｜可以，學習不受年齡完全限制
samples.text: Definitely, I think so. Adults can start learning an instrument, cooking or photography even if they have never tried it before. They may have less free time than teenagers, but they can use life experience and clear personal goals to stay motivated. Talent development is not limited to childhood.

samples.label: Model B｜可以，但方式與目標可能不同
samples.text: Yes, although people may need to adjust their expectations. For example, someone who starts painting after retirement might not become a professional artist, but they can still learn techniques and develop a personal style. Enjoyment, confidence and social connection are valuable outcomes too, so success should not be measured only by fame.

responses.question: Should students pursue artistic talents rather than academics?
angles: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配

arguments.title: 藝術和學業可以互相補充而非二選一
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 創作活動有助培養表達和合作，學業則提供其他知識和發展機會。若時間安排合理，學生未必需要為其中一方完全犧牲另一方。
arguments.englishDemo: **Artistic interests** and **academic learning** can support **balanced development**. With **sensible scheduling**, students can protect **future options** in both areas.

arguments.title: 有突出興趣的學生可以投入更多藝術訓練
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 若學生已清楚了解自己喜愛的藝術領域，也獲得適當指導，可以安排較多時間深入學習。這種選擇應考慮能力、學業需要和長期計劃，不是盲目追求明星夢。
arguments.englishDemo: Students with **strong artistic interests** may benefit from **focused training**. **Individual pathways**, **professional advice** and **long-term planning** can guide responsible decisions.

arguments.title: 基礎學科知識仍有助日後轉換方向
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 年輕人在不同人生階段可能改變興趣或工作，完整的基礎教育能為未來提供彈性。即使希望從事藝術，也可受惠於語言、數學和一般知識。
arguments.englishDemo: **Core subjects** build **transferable knowledge** and preserve **career flexibility**. **Basic education** remains valuable even for students pursuing **creative careers**. These foundations may support unexpected future interests.

arguments.title: 藝術同樣能培養實用的思考能力
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 戲劇、音樂與視覺藝術需要觀察、規劃、修正和合作，這些能力也可轉用於其他學科。故此不宜把藝術一概當成無用的消遣。
arguments.englishDemo: **Creative subjects** develop **problem-solving**, **critical observation**, teamwork and **self-expression**. These skills can support **academic learning** as well. This is particularly valuable in collaborative school projects.

arguments.title: 過早只走藝術路線可能增加職涯風險
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 表演行業的收入及機會未必穩定，年輕人若過早放棄所有其他學習，可能減少未來調整方向的選項。適當保留基礎學業能降低這種風險。
arguments.englishDemo: **Uncertain earnings** and **competitive industries** create **career risks**. Maintaining **academic foundations** offers **alternative options** if plans change. Young people can change their minds as they grow.

arguments.title: 只重視考試成績可能忽略學生的不同長處
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 部分學生在演奏、創作或舞蹈中展現能力，卻未必能透過傳統測驗充分表達。學校應提供多元渠道，讓不同才能得到合理認可。
arguments.englishDemo: An **exam-focused culture** may overlook **creative strengths**. **Broader assessment**, **artistic opportunities** and **diverse achievements** can improve recognition. A wider view of achievement can change expectations.

arguments.title: 藝術活動可提供情緒表達的渠道
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 有些學生利用音樂、繪畫或寫作整理感受，因而更能理解自己。這些活動可支持日常身心健康，但不應被當成所有心理問題的治療方案。
arguments.englishDemo: **Artistic expression** offers **emotional outlets** and **personal reflection**. **Creative activities** may support **everyday wellbeing** alongside appropriate support. These benefits can coexist with academic responsibilities.

arguments.title: 資源不足的學生不應被迫放棄藝術
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 私人課堂和器材費用可能使部分有興趣的學生失去學習機會。校方若提供共享資源和合理課外活動，才能讓「自由選擇」更有實際意義。
arguments.englishDemo: **Equal opportunity** requires **affordable arts education**, **shared facilities** and **accessible programmes**. Otherwise, **financial barriers** may restrict choice. The school can help reduce this gap.

arguments.title: 家長與學生應共同討論而非強行決定
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 藝術與學業的選擇涉及時間、金錢和將來方向，家人可以提供經驗和建議。最好的安排應讓學生表達意願，而不只按家長願望作決策。
arguments.englishDemo: **Family discussions** should respect **student preferences** while considering **practical constraints**. **Shared planning** and **informed choices** can prevent unnecessary conflict. No single family member should decide everything alone.

arguments.title: 不同人生階段可調整藝術與學業比重
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 學生可以在考試期間暫時減少表演，在假期增加排練，也可以按未來目標逐步改變分配。彈性安排往往比永久的單一選擇更可行。
arguments.englishDemo: **Changing priorities** call for **flexible schedules**. Students may increase **creative practice** during holidays while maintaining **academic commitments** and **personal balance**.

arguments.title: 社會需要多種專業而不是只有明星
arguments.angle: 藝術與學業：選擇、平衡及資源分配
arguments.description: 藝術不只包括舞台明星，也涉及教學、設計、技術、行政與文化工作。學業與藝術能力可以組合成多元職業，因此「追求藝術」不一定等於放棄學科。
arguments.englishDemo: **Creative industries** include **technical roles**, **arts education**, design careers and **cultural work**. **Mixed skill sets** can be useful across fields.

samples.label: Model B｜可以，但方式與目標可能不同
samples.text: Students with **strong artistic interests** may benefit from **focused training**. **Individual pathways**, **professional advice** and **long-term planning** can guide responsible decisions.

responses.question: Why does being talented not always lead to success?
angles: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇

arguments.title: 才華不代表已有人看見
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 有能力的人未必得到演出機會、媒體關注或合適的平台。若沒有接觸觀眾的渠道，才能可能長期停留在少數人知道的範圍。
arguments.englishDemo: **Strong talent** does not guarantee **public exposure**. Without **suitable platforms**, **audience access** and **professional opportunities**, recognition may remain limited. Even excellent performances need chances to reach people.

arguments.title: 技巧好也需要持續而可靠的工作態度
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 一次精彩表演可以吸引注意，但長期合作仍依賴守時、準備和尊重他人。若缺乏可靠性，即使技巧很好，也可能難以維持工作機會。
arguments.englishDemo: **Technical ability** is only one part of **professional success**. **Reliability**, **good preparation** and **respectful teamwork** also influence future opportunities. Trust influences whether others want to work together.

arguments.title: 社會和市場需求會影響成功機會
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 某種表演風格即使很有水準，也未必剛好符合當下觀眾需要。市場喜好隨時間改變，這種外在因素不能簡單歸咎於選手不努力。
arguments.englishDemo: **Audience demand** and **market trends** influence **commercial success**. **Excellent skills** may still face **limited opportunities** when preferences change. This does not make artistic value disappear.

arguments.title: 人脈與合作機會可能影響發展
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 有些創作者透過老師、同事或業界活動獲得邀請，另一些人則缺少這些接觸。人脈並不應取代能力，但確實可能影響誰有機會被看見。
arguments.englishDemo: **Professional networks** can create **collaboration offers** and **industry introductions**. People with **limited contacts** may face **access barriers** despite strong skills.

arguments.title: 資金不足會限制培訓和展示
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 器材、上課、錄影和參與演出的交通都涉及成本。即使有天分，經濟條件不足也可能令一些人難以保持長期投入。
arguments.englishDemo: **Financial barriers** can reduce **training access**, **equipment quality** and **promotion opportunities**. **Talent alone** cannot always overcome these disadvantages. Practical support may matter as much as ability.

arguments.title: 合適時機有時比準備程度更難控制
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 同一作品在不同時期可能得到不同回應，節目選角與演出空缺亦可能有限。機遇與準備需要配合，但不應把運氣說成能力不足的證據。
arguments.englishDemo: **Career timing**, **available openings** and **unexpected luck** influence **career progress**. These factors mean **personal ability** is not the whole story.

arguments.title: 缺乏持續練習可能令早期優勢流失
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 有人在初期展示驚人的能力，卻沒有繼續訓練或更新方法。隨着要求提高，單靠天賦可能不足以保持水準。
arguments.englishDemo: **Early promise** needs **consistent practice**, **skill updates** and **adaptability**. Without these, **long-term competitiveness** may decline. Early praise should not replace further development.

arguments.title: 不願接受回饋會限制改進
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 有些表演者對自己的作品十分有信心，但可能忽略有用的建議。若拒絕觀察錯誤或理解觀眾需要，才能便難以轉化成持續進步。
arguments.englishDemo: **Resistance to feedback** can slow **personal growth**. **Honest reflection**, **open-mindedness** and **willingness to adapt** support continued development. Listening carefully is an important professional habit.

arguments.title: 心理與身體負擔可能妨礙發揮
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 長時間壓力、過勞或身體不適會影響選手發揮，即使其能力並沒有消失。取得成功需要可持續的工作條件，不只是短期強撐。
arguments.englishDemo: **Mental pressure**, **physical exhaustion** and **burnout risk** may prevent **consistent performance**. **Supportive conditions** matter alongside talent. A realistic workload protects future creativity and health.

arguments.title: 社會偏見可能使某些才能被低估
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 如果觀眾或機構按外貌、性別、年齡或背景作先入為主的判斷，部分人可能難以獲得公平機會。改善制度比要求受影響者獨自「再努力」更重要。
arguments.englishDemo: **Unfair stereotypes**, **institutional bias** and **unequal treatment** can restrict **fair opportunities**. **Inclusive selection** helps talent receive proper consideration. The problem cannot be solved by effort alone.

arguments.title: 成功也需要把能力轉化成合適作品
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 單有某項技巧未必足夠，創作者仍需了解作品的呈現方式、適合場合和觀眾。這不是要求人人追逐潮流，而是要讓真正的能力可以被清楚理解。
arguments.englishDemo: **Talent presentation**, **clear communication**, **audience awareness** and **appropriate opportunities** help convert **raw ability** into meaningful work. Even strong skills need an audience that understands them.

arguments.title: 成功標準過分狹窄會令成就被忽略
arguments.angle: 能力之外的成功條件、制度與個人選擇
arguments.description: 如果只以獎金、冠軍或網上追蹤人數衡量成功，很多教學、社區或個人創作成就便會被忽略。應先問清楚自己追求的是收入、影響力還是生活滿足。
arguments.englishDemo: **Public fame** is not the only form of **meaningful success**. **Personal fulfilment**, **community contribution** and **creative freedom** may matter more to some people.

samples.label: Model A｜才能以外仍需態度與機會
samples.text: Talent is only one part of success. A skilled performer also needs reliable habits, constructive feedback and opportunities to reach an audience. If someone cannot work with others or stops practising, their ability may not develop further. Even very talented people can face strong competition and difficult timing.

samples.label: Model B｜市場、資源與成功標準也重要
samples.text: I think success also depends on factors people cannot fully control. Someone may be very creative but lack money for training or access to professional networks. Public taste and job opportunities also change. Besides, being successful does not always mean becoming famous; enjoying your work and improving your skills can be meaningful achievements.

structures.english: Perhaps we could start by looking at why …
structures.purpose: 開場並明確指出待討論問題；後接完整名詞子句。

structures.english: From a viewer's perspective, …
structures.purpose: 切換到觀眾／受眾立場，說明具體體驗。

structures.english: From the contestant's point of view, …
structures.purpose: 將焦點放在選手實際得失，而非只談收視。

structures.english: One possible explanation is that …
structures.purpose: 提出一個合理原因，避免把猜測包裝成已證實結論。

structures.english: What makes these shows appealing is …
structures.purpose: 突顯吸引力的關鍵機制；後接名詞或名詞子句。

structures.english: If …, viewers may …
structures.purpose: 以有條件的情境推論觀眾行為；不寫成必然。

structures.english: For example, in a singing competition, …
structures.purpose: 以具體情境支持論點，說明例子代表的機制。

structures.english: Building on your point, I would add that …
structures.purpose: 回應其他組員並加上一條不同的新因果機制。

structures.english: I see why you think that, but …
structures.purpose: 禮貌表達不同看法而不攻擊組員。

structures.english: Just because a show is popular does not mean …
structures.purpose: 反駁把人氣誤等同公平或教育效果的錯誤推論。

structures.english: Could you clarify what you mean by …?
structures.purpose: 對含糊字眼追問定義，例如「成功」或「公平」。

structures.english: Would that still be fair if …?
structures.purpose: 用反例或特殊條件測試一項主張。

structures.english: On the other hand, contestants may …
structures.purpose: 平衡好處與代價、觀眾與選手的不同感受。

structures.english: While I agree that …, we should also consider …
structures.purpose: 先承認合理部分，再補充被忽略的重要因素。

structures.english: We need to distinguish between … and …
structures.purpose: 分清技術能力與人氣、參賽經驗與出名等概念。

structures.english: The risk is greater when …
structures.purpose: 解釋風險隨年齡、挑戰或資源條件而改變。

structures.english: One practical improvement would be to …
structures.purpose: 提出電視公司可考慮採用的具體改進安排。

structures.english: A balance needs to be struck between … and …
structures.purpose: 權衡娛樂效果與私隱、學習與競爭等衝突價值。

structures.english: Shall we compare those options in terms of …?
structures.purpose: 邀請組員用公平、安全、可行性等共同標準比較方案。

structures.english: To sum up, our group seems to agree that …, provided that …
structures.purpose: 有條件地整理共識、保留未解事項並收束討論。
